title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: BETA NOTICE: the settings panel is still under construction; layouts and live previews may contain errors.
INCOMPATIBLE with custom carousel profiles: the old {{v.c_...}} colour macro was removed. Use {{v.c:...}} (for example {{v.c:winrate}}); the default settings already do.

Account manager: new page in General settings. Its switch turns the login-screen button on or off, and Manage accounts opens the manager in the hangar to add, edit or delete accounts. Signing in is still done on the login screen.
Aiming texts: the aiming countdown, shell flight time and penetration templates use {name} fields such as {timer:.1f}, {percent:d} and {countedArmor:d}. Older %(name)s templates keep working.

Target information: the target card uses Gameface in standard battles; events without the Gameface HUD keep the Flash card. The vehicle image sits on its own line and armour/shell columns stay aligned. The penetration message appears above its value.
Team panels: native team panels are supported in Frontline, Black Signal and Stronghold battles.
Reload: manual reload (C by default) sends only the native F8 command, with game-translated messages and minimap effects. The custom reload message setting was removed.
Marks of excellence: the service-record achievement tooltip now comes only from Hangar marks (its Statistic option controls it). The Statistic option of the battle marks was removed.
Settings: sound bank diagnostics moved to general settings; technical loader options are hidden. Shared dossier and colour helpers were consolidated without changing the displayed values.
Compatibility: Python 2.7 and World of Tanks 2.4.1.1 on EU, NA and ASIA. Signed beta release; tested on the EU client.
